children: Otto Alexander, a Director, reported selling common stock in two open-market transactions on September 8 and September 9, 2026. The sales were executed at weighted average prices of $29.68 and $29.59 per share, respectively, with individual price ranges disclosed in footnotes. The total proceeds from the sales amounted to $7,563,164. After the transactions, Otto Alexander directly beneficially owned 6,553,258 shares of common stock.
